hero_heading.name: hero_heading
hero_heading.default: 'The Traditional Latin Mass, offered every week in Cape Town.'

hero_intro.name: hero_intro
hero_intro.default: 'Our Lady of the Blessed Sacrament upholds Catholic tradition and prevails in her call of souls to their everlasting home. All are welcome.'

visit_intro.name: visit_intro
visit_intro.default: 'Once housed in the old local post office, our chapel now stands on the centre square overlooking the park. Whether you are returning to the faith or discovering the ancient liturgy for the first time, you will be warmly received.'

visit_image_caption.name: visit_image_caption
visit_image_caption.default: 'Morning in the park across from the chapel, Pinelands'

quote_latin.name: quote_latin
quote_latin.default: 'Irrequietum est cor nostrum donec requiescat in Te, Domine.'

quote_translation.name: quote_translation
quote_translation.default: 'Our heart, O Lord, is restless, until it finds rest in Thee.'

listen_intro.name: listen_intro
listen_intro.default: 'Missed Sunday, or want to hear a sermon again? Homilies from our chapel and the Society''s official podcast are always available.'

listen_youtube_text.name: listen_youtube_text
listen_youtube_text.default: 'The latest homily appears here automatically each week. Open the channel to hear earlier homilies.'

listen_podcast_title.name: listen_podcast_title
listen_podcast_title.default: 'Interviews, sermons and Q&A with SSPX priests'

listen_podcast_text.name: listen_podcast_text
listen_podcast_text.default: 'The official English-language podcast of the Society, updated weekly.'

community_intro.name: community_intro
community_intro.default: 'Feast days, fêtes, shared meals and Christmas preparations. Life at Our Lady of the Blessed Sacrament extends well beyond Sunday morning.'

school_heading.name: school_heading
school_heading.default: 'Homeschooling with faith at the heart of every subject'

school_body.name: school_body
school_body.default: 'Our Catholic homeschooling curriculum weaves the faith into every subject. Small class sizes give each child individual attention, and a close-knit community binds students, teachers and families together.'

school_emphasis.name: school_emphasis
school_emphasis.default: 'Registrations for the new year open soon.'

give_text.name: give_text
give_text.default: 'Our chapel, its priests and its school are sustained entirely by the generosity of the faithful. Every gift helps keep the Traditional Mass alive in Cape Town.'

contact_intro.name: contact_intro
contact_intro.default: 'For baptisms, weddings, confessions by appointment, sick calls or any question about the faith, send us a message and the priest will reply.'

contact_newsletter_text.name: contact_newsletter_text
contact_newsletter_text.default: 'Join the mailing list for Mass changes, feast days and announcements.'
